# Gamma Co., Ltd. company profile

Gamma Co., Ltd. (Công ty TNHH Gamma) was established on 5 August 2018 and is based in Da Nang.

Gamma offers Gamma Payroll, a payroll service for small businesses.

Management: Đỗ Thành Long, General Director; Mai Phương Thảo, Head of the Human Resources Department; Nguyễn Văn An, Head of the Sales Department.
